# WELCOME TO HIGHLANES .

# Drogheda's Municipal Art Gallery

Highlanes Gallery is a public art gallery and visual arts exhibition centre in Drogheda, Ireland.The gallery opened its doors on October 4, 2006 and was the culmination of many years planning to deliver a dedicated visual arts space for the Irish north east region, of an International standard in terms of design, management and environmental control.

[EXPLORE MORE DETAILS](https://highlanes.ie/about/)

### Explore the Collection

Originally developed by artist Bea Orpen, Husband Terry Trench, and the 1947 Museum Committee, the Drogheda Municipal Art Collection has grown to include more than 100 artworks. From 18th Century paintings to modern sculptures, the collection continues to grow and to showcase a multitude of artist styles & artworks.

[See All Collections](https://highlanes.ie/index.php/collection/?collection_type=type2)
